levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن المبارك
ثمامة بن عبد الله بن أنس بن مالك

notes: The saying is the text of a letter («كتب لهم») relayed by Anas; Abu Bakr is kept as the last link because the words are his letter. This is a judgement, not a rule-11 case.
«أنس بن مالك» occurs inside Thumama's nasab too; the link is the second occurrence.
